subject: GreenLeaf: Control Substantiation & SIG RFI intake
messages:
From: Julia Mercer <julia.mercer@greenleafhealth.com>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@greenleafhealth.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: GreenLeaf SIG + SOC2 intake

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the RFI. Attached is our SIG questionnaire bundle and an initial list of controls we'd like substantiated for our procurement review (see GLH_SIG_Request_20270110.pdf). Key asks from procurement:
- confirmation of SOC 2 scope (which Trust Services Criteria you cover)
- mapping between SIG questions and your SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls
- sample evidence for a subset of controls (audit logs, runbooks, screenshots)

We'd like to kick off intake this week and ideally have a first draft of a control map within 7 business days. Please confirm who on your side will own the artifacts and whether you can provide redacted versions of your most recent SOC 2 report.

Appreciate it — Julia
Julia Mercer
Head of Vendor Assurance, GreenLeaf Health
[Attachment: GLH_SIG_Request_20270110.pdf (PDF)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Mercer <julia.mercer@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: GreenLeaf SIG + SOC2 intake

Julia — thanks for sending. Monica here (Security & Compliance lead for accounts). We can take the lead on the control substantiation. Quick plan: 

1) We will deliver a control mapping spreadsheet (SIG -> SOC 2 trust criteria + ISO 27001 clause) by EOD Jan 17. Initial filename: rls_control_map_v1.xlsx.
2) We will attach a redacted SOC 2 report (2026) and a list of representative artifacts (screenshots, log extracts, runbook excerpts).
3) Aditya will own technical artifacts (runtime logs, KMS policies). Neha will assemble audits/compliance artifacts and steward the Drive folder. Stephanie will be primary PO contact for any legal/contract requests.

Can you confirm the acceptance criteria for "evidence" (e.g., are console screenshots + CSV audit extracts sufficient, or do you need signed attestations)? We'll schedule a 30-min intake call — available Thu/Fri this week.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none on this reply]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Julia Mercer <julia.mercer@greenleafhealth.com>
Date: 2027-01-11T08:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: GreenLeaf SIG + SOC2 intake — technical evidence questions

Folks — following up with some clarifying Qs for GreenLeaf so we prepare exactly what you need: 

- For Data Deletion (SIG control LA-xx / SOC 2 CC6.3 equivalent), do you require:
  * deletion job run logs (timestamp + object IDs) OR
  * screenshots of policy in console + recorded runbook excerpt OR
  * both?
- For KMS/Encryption controls, will an exported policy document and a key-rotation log (CSV with key IDs + rotation timestamps) suffice?
- Any constraints on redaction (customer IDs, KMS ARNs)? We can provide sanitized KMS ARNs and a masking statement.

We plan to put together: rls_control_map_v1.xlsx (mapping + suggested artifact types) and a short artifact guidance doc describing format and redaction rules. If procurement needs signed attestation for any items we can route to Legal but prefer to avoid if screenshots/log extracts are acceptable.

- Aditya
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Julia Mercer <julia.mercer@greenleafhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@greenleafhealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenleafhealth.com>
Date: 2027-01-12T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: GreenLeaf SIG + SOC2 intake — technical evidence questions

Aditya / Monica — thanks, good questions. Procurement acceptance criteria: 
- For deletion: run logs (CSV extract) + a one-paragraph attestation that logs are complete for the requested timeframe. Screenshots are helpful but not sufficient alone.
- For KMS: exported policy + key-rotation CSV is fine; redacted ARNs are OK if you provide a mapping table with placeholders.

We can do an intake call Friday Jan 14, 10:00 AM PT to walk the mapping and agree on the sample artifact set. Please send calendar invite.

Regards,
Julia
[Procurement: they want to see sample artifacts for 6-8 controls initially]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Mercer <julia.mercer@greenleafhealth.com>

Subject: Notes — Intake call with GreenLeaf (Jan 14)

Internal/External attendees: Julia Mercer (GreenLeaf), Tom Alvarez (GreenLeaf), Monica Patel (Redwood), Aditya Rao (Redwood), Neha Kapoor (Redwood), Stephanie Nguyen (Redwood)

Call summary / decisions:
- Agreed: Redwood will deliver initial mapping + sample artifacts for 7 prioritized SIG controls by EOD Jan 17.
- Artifact types accepted: CSV audit extracts, runbook excerpts, console-exported policy docs, and a one-paragraph attestation for completeness.
- Redaction: allowed for PII and customer identifiers; provide a redaction mapping table.
- Deliverables and owners:
  * rls_control_map_v1.xlsx — Monica / Neha (deliver Jan 17)
  * KMS policy & rotation CSV — Aditya (deliver Jan 17)
  * Redacted SOC 2 (2026) — Neha (deliver Jan 17)
  * Intake checklist + evidence guidance PDF — Stephanie (deliver Jan 18)
- Action: Monica to open JIRA SUP-1284 to track artifacts and delivery. Drive folder created and shared: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Aexample/GLH-RFI

Attachments: rls_control_map_v1.xlsx (draft) referenced in delivery list.

--
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Julia Mercer <julia.mercer@greenleafhealth.com>

Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@greenleafhealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenleafhealth.com>
Date: 2027-01-17T15:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Deliverables: control map v1 + SOC 2 report (redacted)

Neha / Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the clarity in the mapping. We received the xlsx and the redacted SOC 2. A couple of follow-ups before procurement moves to PO: 
- Can you provide the key-rotation CSV for the primary KMS key (last 12 months) and a one-paragraph attestation on rotation policy?
- Procurement also requested a sample encryption key rotation log with timestamps (for audit). Will that be available by EOD Jan 20?
- They will push a PO through DocuSign once the KMS artifact is in. I'll send the DocuSign link to complete the PO.

If you can confirm the KMS deliverable timeline we'll mark the ticket green. Thanks again, and please route the rotation CSV to procureops@greenleafhealth.com and drop a copy in the Drive folder.

Best,
Julia Mercer
Head of Vendor Assurance, GreenLeaf Health
[Note: Procurement will expect signed attestation only if CSV extracts are incomplete]
